mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management attributes H1 underperformance to external factors (Ukraine war, supply chain issues, price inflation) rather than operational issues. They frame the EBITDA shortfall as a timing issue with high-margin orders delayed to H2, rather than lost business. They remain confident in achieving full-year guidance despite significant macro uncertainties.

executive_summary: HOVE A/S reported 17% YoY revenue growth to DKK 66.7 million in H1 2022, but EBITDA declined 60% to DKK 1.9 million due to supply chain disruptions and cost inflation from the Ukraine war. Despite these challenges, management maintains full-year guidance of DKK 6-9 million EBITDA, backed by a backlog of high-margin orders and positive progress in new markets (India, Brazil) and new products (IoT, mobile pump for harbor terminals).
key_highlights: Revenue up 17% YoY to DKK 66.7 million (H1 2022)
EBITDA down 60% YoY to DKK 1.9 million due to external factors
